steps.prompt: Dress this exact grey mannequin figure as a plain adult Mexica commoner (macehualli) of Tenochtitlan, clothing as depicted in the Codex Mendoza and the Florentine Codex, shown as a realistic full-body 3D character reference. Keep EXACTLY the same pose (A-pose, arms hanging about 45 degrees away from the torso, hands relaxed), the same body proportions, the same long arm length, the same leg stance and the same framing. Front view, full body, plain white background, even flat lighting, no cast shadows. Clothing: one plain undyed cream cotton tilmatli cloak of matte woven cloth, tied in a single knot on the right shoulder, hanging straight to a straight hem just below the knee, with both arms and forearms bare and free; a plain undyed cotton maxtlatl loincloth beneath; flat simple woven-fibre cactli sandals with thin straps. Warm-brown skin, calm neutral adult face, dark straight hair tied in a low knot at the nape, bare neck visible below the chin. No jewelry, no ear spools, no headband, no feathers, no headdress, no face paint, no tattoos, no weapons, no carried items, no patterns, no dyed colours, no metal.
steps.note: the model knotted the cloak on the figure's left shoulder, so the roster row was set to k = 2 (no second credit)

steps.texture_prompt: Plain undyed cream cotton cloth, matte woven texture, no pattern, no dye; warm-brown skin; dark hair; natural fibre sandals. Flat even albedo, no baked shadows or highlights.
